content.text: {"decision":"block","category":"drugs","reason":"Hulled hemp seeds are a grocery food, but the rules treat hemp-derived cannabis products as cannabis, and this listing is for hemp seed food rather than an extract; since hemp seeds are not clearly cannabis under the banned list, this is a borderline call that I resolve as allowed only if not cannabis."}
